key_insight: IteraSim RAG improves OpenFOAM case generation by splitting retrieval, routing, and agent roles so each part handles a distinct CFD setup problem.
engineering_relevance: This could make open-source CFD more accessible to non-specialists by reducing errors in solver setup, boundary conditions, and turbulence-model selection.
method: LLM expands each query into physics, solver-keyword, and troubleshooting variants.
Reciprocal Rank Fusion combines the ranked lists, then Maximal Marginal Relevance re-ranks candidates from an HNSW dense vector store.
A deterministic router and three-agent workflow (Architect, InputWriter, Reviewer) are backed by a canonical knowledge layer.
evidence_signal: On a released 28-case benchmark, the system achieved 77.9% mean retrieval coverage, with parameter-modification cases exceeding 90%, and all six reference configurations completed successfully on OpenFOAM v2506.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality of the canonical knowledge layer and reviewer loop, so unusual or underdocumented cases may still need human oversight.
paper_title: IteraSim RAG: A Multi-Stage Retrieval-Augmented Agentic Back-End for OpenFOAM-Based Computational Fluid Dynamics
